scope: Host-only pinned mtkclient bulk transfer patch and offline preparation; no USB/device test

transport.cli_scope: Actual extracted writeflash, DAloader, DaHandler and Main tail; initialization and failure trigger are fixtures

limits: Finite budgets are engineering choices, not measured device compatibility.
No preemption of a USB backend ignoring its timeout.
Raw control/exploit/discovery and healthy handshake/XML raw paths are outside the bulk guarantee.
DA framing/status, partition selection, cold state and media durability remain unproved.
Source checker trusts reviewed manifest and host filesystem; it is not a hostile-writer sandbox or durable transaction.
Existing diagnostic artifacts retain their original transport until explicitly migrated.
